description:
All public handler structs in kith-chat/src/ lack doc comments. Affected structs include:

kith-chat/src/contact.rs: ChatContactGetHandler, ChatContactSetHandler, ChatContactChangesHandler, ChatContactQueryHandler, ChatContactQueryChangesHandler — and their ::new() constructors
kith-chat/src/chat.rs: similar handler structs
kith-chat/src/message.rs: similar handler structs
kith-chat/src/permission.rs: resolve_permission function

kith-chat has 32 public items and only 130 doc comment lines — the handler structs and constructors are almost entirely undocumented.

At minimum, each handler struct should have a one-line doc explaining which JMAP method it implements.
title: kith-chat handler structs missing doc comments
